data.name: Rossie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Rhodos', meaning 'rosy' or 'roses'. In Greek mythology, Rhodos was an island where the sun god Helios kept his chariot horses. The island was also a symbol of the goddess Aphrodite and was famed for its beautiful roses. As a name, Rossie carries the symbolism of beauty, love, and the sun.
